journey.name: nearby payments toggle
journey.description:
Settings > General lists "Nearby payments" under Payments, on by default, and the choice survives leaving Settings. The toggle decides whether Receive offers its request to nearby phones over Bluetooth; that broadcast needs two Bluetooth devices and is a manual test in the PR.
Precondition: onboarded dev build wallet that has not changed the setting, start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the menu button (testTag "HeaderMenu") and tap Settings
Scroll the General tab to the Payments section and verify the row "Nearby payments" (testTag "NearbyPaymentsSettings") shows its switch (testTag "NearbyPaymentsToggle") on
Tap the "Nearby payments" row and verify the switch turns off
Press back to leave Settings, open Settings again and verify "Nearby payments" is still off
Tap the "Nearby payments" row and verify the switch is on again
